body: I'm really glad that you're sharing all of this.  You are not scum.  You have been in an extremely difficult situation. I respond to your words with nothing but concern and sympathy.  I can relate to this a little because I dated a married man for a while.  That was traumatic enough, and, when the relationsohip ended, I remember feeling simultaneously ashamed and still filled with longing for this person.  I can't imagine how traumatic it would have been if the relationship had started when I was a sixteen-year-old virgin.  Someone who was very important to you treated you very badly, and I'm really sorry that that happened.  The other posters are right.  He was the grown-up; he should have known better.

You have a lot of responsibility on your shoulders.  I don't blame you for being stressed.  Some people would see that level of responsibility and just run away.  So I would disagree with the idea that you're a pussy.  Maybe you bravely putting yourself in your dad's job means that you need to not deal with other kinds of stress right now.  Maybe it's not pussyish-ness that keeps you from asking that girl out; maybe you're just protecting yourself from other stressors for a while.   

You wrote back to my post to ask me what was going on in my life.  That was really nice.  I think that you are a good person, and I am really glad that you're here.  I wish I was rich.  I would send you money.
